stories.h: Eisenkot warns caretaker Netanyahu against non-urgent military moves
stories.s: In a letter, Eisenkot urged Netanyahu to hold off on major security decisions until a new government forms, amid reported Iran tensions with the IDF chief. He also asked the attorney general to secure briefings for him. The PMO called the letter irresponsible.

stories.h: Trump and Netanyahu reportedly clash in heated Iran call
stories.s: Ynet reports a weekend phone call turned into a shouting match: Netanyahu pushed to restart strikes on Iran and Trump wanted more time for diplomacy. Netanyahu's office called the report fake news. Rubio said Washington isn't preparing new strikes.

stories.h: Netanyahu blames Hamas for flooded Gaza camps
stories.s: Netanyahu rejected claims that Israel is holding up winter supplies and blamed Hamas, which he said is diverting aid. The UN says more than 150,000 tents and flood pumps are waiting for Israeli approval. Israeli strikes in Gaza City killed three.

stories.h: Eisenkot cancels Likud talks after Netanyahu's Knesset speech
stories.s: Netanyahu's call for a unity government at the new Knesset's opening drew heckling. Eisenkot called the speech divisive and disgraceful, and his Yashar party cancelled a planned meeting with Likud's negotiators.
